title: Agent conversation
setup: Bee Team automatically creates and reuses this agent’s workspace. The conversation starts with your first request.
retry: Check send with the same key
retryAction: Retry the previous action before starting another.
welcomeHint: Send a request to start a conversation with this agent.
welcomeHq: I'm the Bee Team guide. I can set up teams, agents and boards with you — pick a starting point or just type.
composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
starterTeamPrompt: I want to create my first team. Help me define its goal, leader and roles.
starterAgentPrompt: I want to create a new agent. Ask me what it should do and suggest a name and instructions.
starterBoardPrompt: I want to create a board to organize work. Suggest columns and the first tasks.
starterTourPrompt: Explain in a few steps how teams, agents, boards and tasks work together in Bee Team.
